verified_exact_locator_evidence.supported_statement: The study states that it works with Mundari spoken in Jharkhand and written in Devanagari.
The paper reports audio recordings for 15,656 unique Mundari sentences and a speech corpus of 26,868 recordings totaling 27.51 hours.
